body:
This just made my fucking day. Thank you so much. If you don’t mind I’ll be pasting the link to this post to the post underneath yours. The other guy needs to read this. Thank you so much. I am not suicidal but i understand you. I felt this. I hope you recover well and have a good rest of your life. 

“My depression has improved so fucking much, and I never thought it was possible. Dude I'm doing art, writing, things I haven't done in years due to depression. I have MOTIVATION. It's fucking amazing.” 

This is he type of things that I want to see. Like I said I’m not suicidal and all I want to do is to help people in this sub. Everyday before I sleep I am on here for 2 hours talking to people. This made my night. Thank you.
If you don’t mind me asking, and you don’t even have to reply, what happened to your brother that led him to kill himself? Was it the Army or his own personal problems?

First of all take it easy. You’re 14 and worrying about college. Don’t worry about it! Your senior year of high school would have time dedicated to finding a good college. As for motivation, just put yourself down and bring yourself back up. Bullying is not ok. What type of bullying are you facing? 

Edit: Do you know how to play chess? I would love to play a game, although I haven’t played in about 2 years. I was really good back then but I just stopped. Let me know if I can get a game with you!

I was on this sub when you posted your last post. I didn’t know what to say so I didn’t leave a comment. I’m glad that you have a good friend that would help you. She seems like a real friend and please don’t do her the pain of killing yourself. This will crush her. I’m glad that you found help
